+---
+assignees:

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8380'
+title: Delete the permit loan and the human-wait release; keep the same-session re-entry refusal on a light task-local
+---
+## Why
+
+With no turn-long gate, three workarounds have no purpose: the `awaitingUser` release and re-acquire, `GenerationPermitLoan`, and `withGenerationLent`. A person wait holds nothing, and a nested generation goes into the queue while the outer turn is in its tool.
+
+## What to do
+
+1. Delete `GenerationPermitLoan`, `borrowsGenerationPermit`, `currentPermitLoan`, and `withGenerationLent` (`Session/GenerationReentry.swift`). Remove the calls in `Hosting/RunToCompletionRunner.swift:98`, `Hosting/ContextBindingTool.swift:123`, `Hosting/BackgroundToolRunner.swift:123`, and the loan in `runCancellableModelCall` (`Session/RoutedSessionActorTurnExecution.swift:618-638`, `:655`).
+2. Keep `SessionReentryError.sameSessionTurnInFlight` and `isInsideOwnTurnToolCall` (`Session/RoutedSessionActorTurnGating.swift:69-80`). Base them on a new light task-local "this session is in a model call", bound in the model-call task, in place of the loan. `turnLock` is held for the whole turn, so a same-session turn from a tool must still be refused with a clear error, never park.
+3. Keep `awaitingUser(_:)` in the public `RoutedSession` protocol, so consumers do not break. It becomes a pass-through (`body()` only). Delete `humanWaitDepth`, `humanWaitLenderTurnId`, `beginHumanWait`, `endHumanWait`. The memory `routed-session-cancellation-invariants` names `endHumanWait()` re-validation; that invariant goes away with the code. Update that memory in the same change.
+4. Write the new contract in the doc comment of `awaitingUser(_:)` (`RoutedSession.swift:254-260`).
+
+## Tests to change
+
+`HumanWaitGateTests`, `NestedGenerationReentryTests`, and the other files that name the loan (`rg -l "GenerationPermitLoan|awaitingUser|withGenerationLent" Tests`).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] The agents case: a parent session in a tool body starts a child turn on the same model (different session) and waits for it in that tool. The child completes, then the parent completes. With a timeout, so a regression fails and does not hang.
+- [ ] A tool that asks its own session for a turn or a fork gets `sameSessionTurnInFlight`.
+- [ ] A person wait inside `awaitingUser` holds no queue place: another session completes a turn during it.
+- [ ] A background run (`BackgroundToolRunner`) that generates on the same model after its turn ended completes.
+- [ ] No symbol named `GenerationPermitLoan` or `withGenerationLent` stays in `Sources/`. The full suite is green. #generation-queue
\ No newline at end of file
